system_title: SCHEMA: Scoring Candidates via Heuristic Evaluation Model Architecture

questions.label: Workload & Time Triage
questions.prompt: Aside from classes, what other commitments do you have, and how do you triage colliding deadlines?
questions.pass_criteria: Has a concrete task system (Calendar/Notion); confirms 4+ hrs/week availability.
questions.fail_criteria: Vague answers; admits having 3+ major orgs/heavy capstone without a management plan.

questions.label: Accountability & Conflict Resolution
questions.prompt: Tell us about a time a groupmate was unresponsive or delayed. How did you handle it?
questions.pass_criteria: Direct, early communication; clarified blockers; escalated professionally without toxicity.
questions.fail_criteria: Stayed silent and did all work alone, or blamed aggressively without resolution.

questions.label: SBD Alignment & Motivation
questions.prompt: Why did you choose to apply to SBD, and what is one specific thing you want to learn this term?
questions.pass_criteria: Names specific technical growth, community building, or project portfolio goals.
questions.fail_criteria: Generic answer ('just want experience'); cannot name anything specific about SBD.

questions.label: Attendance & Sync Commitment
questions.prompt: Can you commit to weekly async updates and attending our scheduled sprint syncs?
questions.pass_criteria: Unambiguous 'Yes'; confirms no recurring blackout on team meeting windows.
questions.fail_criteria: Hesitant; notes recurring conflicts on core meeting days.

questions.label: Domain Intent
questions.prompt: What drew you to IoT & Robotics over pure software apps?
questions.pass_criteria: Mentions sensors, actuators, hardware+software, physical constraints, or embedded systems.
questions.fail_criteria: Only software UI interest; ignores physical world.

questions.label: Applied Thinking
questions.prompt: Map a smart device routine as a pipeline: sense -> decide -> act -> fail-safe.
questions.pass_criteria: All four stages present with a concrete example.
questions.fail_criteria: No sense of feedback or failure modes.

questions.label: Self-Unblocking & Experimentation
questions.prompt: Describe a time hardware or a prototype misbehaved. How did you debug it?
questions.pass_criteria: Checks wiring/power/code; divides problem; tests minimally.
questions.fail_criteria: Replaced everything at once; no method.

questions.label: Conviction & Builder Mindset
questions.prompt: Given the self-directed nature of IoT & Robotics, why are you the right fit to build with us?
questions.pass_criteria: Realistic confidence; highlights grit, curiosity, and eagerness to self-study.
questions.fail_criteria: Over-promises without backing; expects a classroom lecture format.
